title: Old-ST Domain Generator
description: Scaffold a complete new domain: domain package, contracts package, API service (optional), and CRUD use cases.

name.x-prompt: What is the domain name (kebab-case, e.g. shipping)?

entity.description: Entity name in kebab-case singular (default: same as domain). Drives entity class, repository, and contract names.

fields.description: Comma-separated field specs, e.g. 'orderId:string,trackingNumber:string,weight:number,address:string?'. Allowed types: string, number, boolean, date. Suffix '?' marks the field optional.

statuses.description: Comma-separated SCREAMING_SNAKE statuses, e.g. 'PENDING,IN_TRANSIT,DELIVERED,CANCELLED'. Defaults to 'ACTIVE,DELETED'.

withService.description: Also scaffold the API service shell (apps/{name}/{name}-api-service).

publishesEvents.description: If true, the service publishes domain events to SQS. Adds {DOMAIN}_SQS_QUEUE_URL/_NAME env vars and the registry entry. Default false.

useCases.description: Comma-separated CRUD use cases to scaffold. Supported: create, get-by-id, update, delete, list. Action use cases must be added separately via the use-case generator.

dryRun.description: Print the file plan without writing anything.
